planRows.censusName: York Medellin, Curio Collection by Hilton

applyFields.Hotel Description: Located in El Poblado, we’re close to Club Campestre de Medellin. El Castillo Museum and Gardens, shops, and several restaurants within a 10-minute drive. Enjoy panoramic views of the Medellin skyline and mountains from our rooftop pool and lounge.  Meeting space is available for guest use.

planRows.censusName: Perla La Paz, Tapestry Collection by Hilton

applyFields.Hotel Description: Our charming hotel, housed in a historic building, offers stunning oceanfront views. We are located in the heart of La Paz Sea boardwalk - Malecón, overlooking the beach. Adjacent to us is the Whale Shark Encounter and other sought-after La Paz tours, making us an ideal choice for those looking to explore.

planRows.censusName: Punta Sal Suites and Bungalows, Curio Collection by Hilton

applyFields.Hotel Description: Set along more than a kilometer of pristine, private shoreline in northern Peru, the resort offers calm waters and year‑round sun in a truly secluded setting. Guests stay just steps from the sand in suites with private terraces and panoramic ocean views. Local cuisine and cocktails are served in a relaxed beachfront atmosphere.

planRows.censusName: Amare Cancun Adults Only All-Inclusive Resort, Curio Collection by Hilton

applyFields.Hotel Description: Overlooking Isla Mujeres from Cancun's Hotel Zone, we offer easy access to snorkeling, diving, catamaran trips and archaeological sites like Tulum, Chichen Itza, and Coba. Guests can enjoy two rooftops with pools, bars, and grills. A beachfront setting adds to the experience and signed culinary concepts elevate every stay.

planRows.censusName: Chelsea Bogota Parque 93, Tapestry Collection by Hilton

applyFields.Hotel Description: We’re near Parque 93 - one of Bogotá’s most vibrant districts, known for upscale dining, nightlife, outdoor cafés, and cultural events. Zona Rosa and Andino Shopping Mall are two kilometers from us. Bogotá Financial District and corporate hubs are within 15 minutes. Enjoy on-site dining, our rooftop terrace, meeting space, and wellness amenities.
